value: Rolling averages only at 30 days; negative averages clipped to 0
Exclude per-customer first calendar month only after calculating cumulative and rolling values

value.expression: Each customer first transaction day through global last recorded transaction day inclusive; monthly first transaction calendar month is baseline excluded after windows

basis.rationale: Common observation cutoff; do not infer customer closure from last transaction; no extrapolation after known data cutoff

population.missing.value: Full calendar spine; no transaction day has zero net and carried closing

value.description: Daily net signed transaction sum, cumulative customer daily closing, arithmetic average over current day plus preceding 29 calendar days only at 30 rows, MAX(avg30,0), maximum per customer calendar month, exclude first transaction month, SUM customer monthly maxima

measure.countGrain.value: One calendar-day closing per customer; monthly max one per customer-month

measure.denominator.value: Exactly 30 calendar daily closings per valid rolling average

measure.window.value: Cumulative from customer first transaction day and rolling current day plus 29 preceding calendar days inclusive, require count=30

For each customer and each day
only after having 30 days of data, and treating negative averages as zero

candidates.sql: WITH RECURSIVE daily_net AS (SELECT customer_id,date(txn_date) d,SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type='deposit' THEN txn_amount ELSE -txn_amount END) net FROM customer_transactions GROUP BY customer_id,d), bounds AS (SELECT customer_id,MIN(d) first_d,MAX(d) last_d FROM daily_net GROUP BY customer_id), spine(customer_id,d,first_d) AS (SELECT customer_id,first_d,first_d FROM bounds UNION ALL SELECT customer_id,date(d,'+1 day'),first_d FROM spine WHERE d<(SELECT MAX(d) FROM daily_net)), filled AS (SELECT s.customer_id,s.d,s.first_d,COALESCE(n.net,0) net FROM spine s LEFT JOIN daily_net n ON s.customer_id=n.customer_id AND s.d=n.d), balance AS (SELECT *,SUM(net) OVER(PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY d ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) closing FROM filled), rolling AS (SELECT *,COUNT(*) OVER(PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY d ROWS BETWEEN 29 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) days,AVG(closing) OVER(PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY d ROWS BETWEEN 29 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) avg30,SUM(closing) OVER(PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY d ROWS BETWEEN 29 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) sum30 FROM balance), monthly_max AS (SELECT customer_id,date(d,'start of month') m,MAX(MAX(avg30,0)) max_avg30 FROM rolling WHERE days=30 AND date(d,'start of month')>date(first_d,'start of month') GROUP BY customer_id,m) SELECT m month,SUM(max_avg30) total_max_avg30 FROM monthly_max GROUP BY m ORDER BY m
